```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import json

subject    = r.params["subject"]
export_dir = Path(r.params["export_dir"])
joined     = pd.read_csv(export_dir / f"{subject}_trials_joined.csv")
metrics    = json.loads((export_dir / f"{subject}_metrics.json").read_text())
joined.head()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(readr)

theme_mous <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1, color = "#0f172a"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "#64748b", size = base_size - 1, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "#475569", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "#64748b"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 11, color = "#334155"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 10, color = "#475569")
    )
}

COND_COLORS <- c("ZINNEN" = "#2563eb", "WOORDEN" = "#16a34a", "REST" = "#d97706")

subject    <- params$subject
export_dir <- params$export_dir
joined <- read_csv(
  file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_trials_joined.csv")),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
joined$condition <- factor(joined$condition)
```

## Mixed-Effects Model: MTG β ~ MEG Features

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
fit <- lmer(
  mtg_beta ~ prestim_beta + n400m + dci_trial + condition + pos_in_block + (1 | block_id),
  data = joined
)
summary(fit)
```

## Pre-stim β → MTG BOLD

```{r}
#| label: fig-meg-fmri-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Scatter of MEG pre-stimulus β power vs. left-MTG fMRI β weight, coloured by condition. Lines are per-condition OLS fits."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(joined, aes(x = prestim_beta, y = mtg_beta, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLORS, name = "Condition") +
  theme_mous() +
  labs(
    title    = paste("MEG–fMRI coupling –", subject),
    subtitle = "Pre-stimulus beta power predicts left-MTG BOLD response",
    x = "Pre-stim β power (MEG, a.u.)",
    y = "Left-MTG β weight (fMRI)"
  )
```

## HRF lag sweep diagnostics (if available)

```{python}
lag_rows = []
lag = metrics.get("m11_coupling_hrf_lag_sweep", {})
if isinstance(lag, dict):
    for label, payload in sorted(lag.items()):
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            continue
        z = payload.get("zinnen_prestim_beta_vs_mtg", {})
        w = payload.get("woorden_prestim_beta_vs_mtg", {})
        lag_rows.append(
            {
                "lag_label": label,
                "zinnen_r": z.get("r") if isinstance(z, dict) else None,
                "woorden_r": w.get("r") if isinstance(w, dict) else None,
            }
        )
pd.DataFrame(lag_rows).style.format(precision=4) if lag_rows else print("No lag-sweep metrics found.")
```
